art_direction: A bright, clever YouTube thumbnail: Dave in a dark navy shirt stands beside a tall wooden filing cabinet in his home office. One drawer is pulled open and packed with printed photos of his own face, with clean index tabs reading SHOCKED, THINKING, SMUG and HAPPY. A small, neat white robotic arm reaches into the drawer and lifts out one print (a shocked face), holding it up. Dave leans in, surprised and amused, eyebrows up, pointing at the print. Soft daylight from a window, one warm desk lamp. Keep the LEFT THIRD a plain wall for a headline.

video.working_title: I Turned My Headshots Into an AI Picker
video.promise: Demonstrate a system that uses 106 tagged headshots and AI to select an appropriate thumbnail portrait

creative.story: My faces are filed by expression, and AI pulls the right one

presenter.reference_pool: David's favourites (neutrals); expression and pose are set here, not by the photo

performance_to_create.pose: Leaning toward the drawer, pointing at the lifted print

quality_checks: Looks like the style reference board, not a light show
